title: Moreish Puff Soda Cherry Cola Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Who doesn’t love a sweet, rich, refreshing cherry cola? The classic soda gets the Moreish Puff treatment in this irresistible e-liquid, which delivers the sweet, caramel depth of authentic cola with the tangy kick of cherry. Moreish Puff’s Nic Salt e-liquid’s nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief and smooth throat hit provided by nic salts.
